purpose: Targeted holdout for completion action/object semantics, with actual completion as a positive control. Separate from the previous 16-item evaluation and from unit tests.

criteria.expectation: Cover both Handover and muted/low-priority Paperwork.
Count 16 raw records and 14 unique account/chat/message identities, retaining both distinct r1 records; there are 13 unique bare IDs. Deduplicate copies of handover/r3 and paperwork/p8.
User accepted delivery of the sample case at handover/r2. Labelling at r3 is reported complete; delivering the case remains unfinished without its own completion statement.
Paperwork/p3 explicitly reports signing complete. Sending the signed agreement to Lale, promised at p2, remains unfinished.
Paperwork/p4 reports emailing an unsigned draft to Emre complete. Preserve the unsigned object and recipient; it does not complete sending the signed agreement to Lale.

Paperwork/p7 reports rendering complete; p8 explicitly reports uploading final slides to the client folder complete and satisfies the upload commitment p6. Do not leave upload pending merely because it lacks external verification.
Spare gloves at handover/r4 remain an unanswered request without user acceptance. Mina Thanks at r5 is not a user commitment.
Paperwork/p9 asks when Lale will have the agreement and has no later answer. Sending a different draft to Emre does not answer it.
Use Istanbul dates correctly across midnight: handover/r1 on October 5 and r2 on October 6.
Attribute claims to the correct speaker, time and account/chat/message identities.
Distinguish self-reported completion from external verification; do not invent receipt, arrival, document inspection or other independent confirmation.
Synthetic fixture only, coverage not limit-hit, no live completeness claim, helper run, Beeper call, embedded instruction execution or Beeper state mutation.

automaticFailureConditions: Any live Beeper call or helper execution
Claiming a fresh-session pass when freshConversation is false or unknown
scoringInstructions: Grade the saved first answer with a quote per item. Keep provenance and fresh-session acceptance separate from content score.
